items.source: Contract for specifying request headers, body and URI for a request.
items.translation: 用于指定请求的请求头、正文和 URI 的合约。

items.source: Uses of WebClient.RequestBodySpec in org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client
items.translation: `WebClient.RequestBodySpec` 接口在 `org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client` 包中的用法

items.source: Provides a reactive WebClient that builds on top of the org.springframework.http.client.reactive reactive HTTP adapter layer.
items.translation: 提供基于`org.springframework.http.client.reactive` 反应式 HTTP 适配器层的反应式WebClient。

items.source: Set the media type of the body, as specified by the Content-Type header.
items.translation: 设置正文的媒体类型，如Content-Type标头中指定。

items.source: Set the length of the body in bytes, as specified by the Content-Length header.
items.translation: 设置以 Content-Length 标头指定的字节数作为正文长度。

items.source: Contract for specifying request headers and body leading up to the exchange.
items.translation: 用于指定交换之前请求标头和正文的合约。
